description: Homescoope recipes pin upstream library versions in packages/*/recipe.yaml.
A custom regex manager reads `# renovate: …` comments above `version:` and opens one PR per package when upstream cuts a release.

Recipe automerge only for packages listed in scripts/ci-certified.json (full cert/*.mjs checklist + negative proof); the merge queue still requires cert-review, and every publish needs its certified= line. Majors and new packages stay manual.

Extends the shared SLICC preset, which turns automerge on globally. Here, any merged change under packages/** can publish, so the rules below turn automerge off for packages/**, @ai-ecoverse re-pins and the publish-path workflows; only the CI-certified non-major recipe rule turns it back on.

binutils.description: GNU binutils release tarballs (git tags are binutils-2_47, which no versioning reads as 2.47)

curl.description: curl release tarballs (tags are curl-8_22_0, which extractVersion can't turn into a version)

curl-cacert.description: curl's dated extracts of Mozilla's CA certificate store (cacert-YYYY-MM-DD.pem), for tls-engine's roots.der. A bump also needs the sha256 in packages/tls-engine/recipe.yaml and slicc.tls.roots in its package.json; the build fails closed until both match.

customManagers.description: Homebrew-shaped recipe.yaml upstream pins (see # renovate comments). depName is optional: a pin without one (perl-version, python-version, golang-version) is named after its datasource.
wasi-sdk pin in scripts/install-wasi-sdk.sh (# renovate comment above WASI_SDK_MAJOR). A bump also needs the two sha256 pins in that file; the install fails closed until they are updated.

packageRules.description: Anything under packages/** can publish once merged: no automerge (the shared preset turns it on globally). Only the CI-certified recipe rule below turns it back on.
Default: recipe bumps do not automerge until CI-certified.
Semver majors on recipes: always human (Lars).
CI-certified packages (see scripts/ci-certified.json) — non-major only; automerge scope, not a publish gate. Synced by scripts/sync-ci-certified-renovate.mjs.
@ai-ecoverse pins in a shipped package.json are re-pin waves: each one is a packaging release that needs a cert, so never automerge.
libpng 1.7 is a parallel beta line; stay on the 1.6.x stable series.
vim tags move fast; xxd tracks a pinned patch — ignore majors.
Workflow action pins below a major.
The publish path (ladder-*.yml) and cert-review.yml, whose status feeds the publish gate: action and pin bumps there are reviewed by hand, never automerged.
github-script major bumps can break ladder-merge; review by hand.
cmake: build.sh relinks a prebuilt slicc-emscripten cmake-wasm-build tree that CI does not have, so a Renovate bump can never go green (#30). Off until cmake is CI-buildable.

py-* C++ side modules (numpy, pandas, scipy, matplotlib, contourpy, kiwisolver): upstream bumps need a wasix side-module rebuild on the current sysroot runtimes and move the whole numpy C-API stack together; they ride homescoop#211 (py-* C++ stack v2), not single-package Renovate PRs (#31, #32, #38). Re-pins onto a new wasix-python are packaging-only repacks.

wasm-emscripten's third-party npm dependencies (typescript, esbuild-wasm, acorn, …) mirror upstream emscripten's own package.json at the pinned emscripten release, so they move with the emscripten version, never alone (#325: typescript 7 broke host-build). @ai-ecoverse pins are bumped by the builder.
Semver majors of anything (recipes, workflow actions, npm, Cargo) stay human: never automerge.
crates/** (the shared Rust crates): ladder-pr builds no dependent package for a crates-only PR, so CI would not test what a bump affects. Never automerge.

Root package.json devDependencies are our own test pins (cert kernel, shared harness, playwright): a bump merges by hand once that version is certified (Lars), so an uncertified kernel never reaches every cert run.
slicc-kernel-negative is the pinned old kernel (npm alias) the negative proofs must fail on (#393); a bump would break the proof.
Renovate has no perl-version datasource: wasix-perl's pin reads Perl's release tags (stable 5.even.N) instead, without touching the recipe.

Retired recipes (builder: retired): no Renovate PRs for any file in their package directory (recipe pins, Cargo.toml, go.mod). They are built, if at all, by their own workflows from pinned sources (e.g. wasi-rustc-stable.yml), so a recipe bump builds nothing. Synced by scripts/sync-ci-certified-renovate.mjs.
